Returns: A JSON string containing the structured data, or an error message if something went wrong., , >>> input_text = "The conference will be held on June 10-12, 2024 at the Grand Hotel.", "object", "properties": {"event_start_date": {"type": "string", "format": "date"}}}', >>> result = text_to_json(input_text, schema), >>> print(result), {, "2024-06-10", }
